title: workflow-resilience-check telemetry data
description: Per-hook `data` payload for the workflow-resilience-check advisory. Discovered from the envelope `hook` value "workflow-resilience-check". Evolves additive-only. Status is always "ok" — this hook never blocks. Emitted for every meaningful outcome (no fan-out / already-throttled / advisory finding), not for a pure inapplicability short-circuit (no script content at all).

tool.description: Always empty — this advisory has no single tool/file subject (it inspects a Workflow tool's inline script or scriptPath).

findings.description: The resilience advisory text when the script fans out with no throttle/retry primitives, as a single-element array. Empty array when the script doesn't fan out, or already applies inWaves/inWavesPipeline/agentRetry.
